data.text/markdown:
A map of local housing models

Where should a model share information? Nearby houses need not have identical price relationships, yet fitting an independent regression in every small region wastes information. A geographical grid gives us a concrete way to express proximity. Explore a small offline synthetic adaptation, or explicitly run a King County experiment following Tuck, Barratt & Boyd (2021), §5.2, pp.19–21. The original-data preset uses a 50 × 50 grid, nine covariates plus an intercept, natural log sale prices, five folds, and an independently fitted scaler in every fold.

data.text/html: The original-data grid is always 50 × 50. Its full evaluation includes 100-tree forests and is intentionally opt-in.
320 sales · 3 covariates + intercept · 16 local models. The target is already in log-price units; the optimizer does not transform it.

data.text/markdown:
A geographical model is an explicit composition

Two fixed-width bin transforms create latitude and longitude labels. Their domains are declared constants tied to the reviewed data snapshot. We do not learn grid boundaries, standardization parameters, or model parameters from validation folds. Latitude and longitude select the local model; they are not among its nine regressors. The local L2 penalty excludes the intercept. Both geographical graph penalties include it, allowing a location-dependent baseline price. The same graph weight is applied to each grid direction. Objective units matter. The authors' code uses summed squared residuals; this package uses sum(residual²) / (2 * n_train). With matching half-scaled L2 and graph penalties, the equivalent new weights are paper_weight / (2 * n_train). The target is natural log price throughout: reported RMSE is not a dollar error. These half factors were checked independently: Appendix A, p.28 defines the local sum-of-squares function with one half, and the inspected source implements lambda * sum(theta²) / 2; equation (2), p.7 puts one half on undirected graph energy. Section 5.2 does not itself display r(theta). If it were interpreted as unhalved local L2 instead, only the package L2 weight would double. This preset records the appendix/source convention explicitly.
